prompts.title: 带水花飞溅的化妆品产品图
prompts.description: 一个详细的技术提示，用于生成一个圆柱形琥珀色化妆品瓶（ACID POTION）的商业产品照片，瓶身带有冷凝水珠和动态水花飞溅效果，置于极简渐变背景前，并采用高对比度逆光照明。
prompts.content: IMAGE: A cylindrical cosmetic bottle stands centered and vertically upright in the frame, bottom-weighted with the base resting on a dark, rounded platform that curves gently across the lower edge; the camera presents a front-facing view of the bottle at approximately eye level relative to the center of the label, with no tilt, and the subject is oriented straight and symmetrical, though the cap is slightly offset by lighting and perspective; the top of the cap sits close to the upper edge but remains fully visible, while the base is cropped just below the platform edge, suggesting the bottle continues downward beyond the frame; the bottle has a smooth cylindrical form with softly rounded shoulders and a short neck topped by a spherical, matte black cap. woman's hand  touching the top cap to open it; the material appears to be semi-translucent frosted glass in a warm amber tone, with condensation droplets and streaks of water clinging to the surface, creating irregular, organic patterns across the front and sides; a splash of water arcs outward from the right side of the bottle at mid-height, forming thin, curved ribbons and droplets frozen in motion, extending into the negative space on the right; the background is a clean, pale gray to light blue gradient with no visible environmental details, creating a studio-like, minimal depth; the camera distance is moderately close, likely using a normal to short telephoto focal length, producing minimal distortion and a slightly compressed, product-focused perspective; the entire bottle and splash are in sharp focus, indicating a controlled depth of field with crisp edges and fine detail in the water droplets; lighting appears strong and directional from behind and slightly above, creating a bright, glowing highlight through the translucent glass and illuminating the liquid inside, while also producing specular highlights on the water droplets; the light creates sharp reflections and a halo-like glow around the cap and shoulders, with softer fill light from the front to keep the label legible; visible effects include high-contrast backlighting, bright specular highlights, subtle bloom around the brightest reflections, and a clean, commercial-grade color grade emphasizing warm amber tones against the cool neutral background; the palette is dominated by warm amber and golden hues within the bottle, contrasted by cool gray-blue background tones and the deep black of the cap and base; the atmosphere is clear with no haze, but the presence of water droplets and the dynamic splash suggests recent motion, frozen at the moment of impact or pour. TEXT: Logo: “Moon Juice”; Title: “ACID POTION”; Body: “Resurfacing Exfoliator”; Other: “Resurfaçage Exfoliant”.
prompts.translatedContent: 图片：一个圆柱形化妆品瓶居中垂直立于画面中，底部较重，瓶底置于一个深色、圆润的平台上，平台在下边缘处轻柔弯曲；相机以大约与标签中心齐平的视线高度，正面拍摄瓶身，无倾斜，主体笔直对称，尽管瓶盖因光线和透视略有偏移；瓶盖顶部靠近上边缘但完全可见，而瓶底在平台边缘下方被裁剪，暗示瓶身向下延伸超出画面；瓶身呈光滑的圆柱形，肩部柔和圆润，颈部较短，顶部是球形哑光黑色瓶盖。一只女人的手正在触摸瓶盖顶部以将其打开；材质似乎是半透明的磨砂玻璃，呈温暖的琥珀色调，表面附着冷凝水滴和水痕，在正面和侧面形成不规则的有机图案；一股水花从中等高度从瓶身右侧向外飞溅，形成纤细、弯曲的水带和凝固的水滴，延伸到右侧的负空间；背景是干净的浅灰色到浅蓝色渐变，没有可见的环境细节，营造出工作室般的极简景深；相机距离适中，可能使用了标准到短焦距镜头，产生最小的畸变和略微压缩、以产品为中心的视角；整个瓶身和水花都清晰对焦，表明景深受控，水滴边缘清晰，细节丰富；光线似乎从后方和略上方强烈定向照射，通过半透明玻璃产生明亮的辉光，照亮内部液体，同时在水滴上产生镜面高光；光线在瓶盖和肩部周围形成锐利的反光和光晕，前方有柔和的补光以保持标签清晰可辨；可见效果包括高对比度背光、明亮的镜面高光、最亮反光周围的微妙光晕，以及强调暖琥珀色调与冷中性背景对比的干净商业级色彩分级；调色板以瓶内的暖琥珀色和金色调为主，与冷灰蓝色背景色调以及瓶盖和瓶底的深黑色形成对比；气氛清晰无雾霾，但水滴和动态水花的存在暗示着最近的运动，凝固在撞击或倾倒的瞬间。文字：Logo：“Moon Juice”；标题：“ACID POTION”；正文：“Resurfacing Exfoliator”；其他：“Resurfaçage Exfoliant”。

prompts.content:
ONE-CLICK GENERIC MASTER PROMPT — ANCIENT JUNGLE MORNING
STYLE
High-end cinematic stylized-realism digital concept art, AAA environment
keyframe illustration, film matte-painting depth construction, professional
game environment rendering, minimal line art, value-driven form separation,
painted edges, controlled edge hierarchy, large-to-small mass construction,
clean gradient digital color blending, hybrid hand-painted procedural texture,
macro readability prioritized with selective micro-detail in focal structures,
studio-quality composition, polished senior-level production finish.
SUBJECT / SCENE
In an Ancient Jungle Morning Setting, a long-abandoned jungle city plaza with cracked statues and vine-covered arches.
ENVIRONMENT
Primeval overgrown jungle landscape with monumental ancient natural formations,
dense layered vegetation, colossal trees, tangled roots, mist-filled clearings,
hidden stone remnants or forgotten pathways partially reclaimed by nature.
Large readable terrain masses first, with deep environmental layering and
strong spatial separation between foreground foliage, mid jungle structures,
and distant canopy silhouettes.
LIGHTING
Fresh early-morning jungle illumination with low-angle sunlight filtering
through dense canopy gaps in structured directional shafts. Light should
clearly define major structural planes while allowing gentle atmospheric mist
to separate depth layers and enhance spatial readability without obscuring
primary forms.
CAMERA
Cinematic exploration-style wide establishing shot positioned slightly above
ground level as if the viewer has just discovered the scene. Use natural
foreground framing through vegetation or terrain forms, clear midground focal
anchor, and deep layered jungle distance to reinforce cinematic matte-painting
depth construction.
MOOD
Sense of ancient discovery, untouched history, and quiet natural majesty.
The scene should feel like the first reveal of a lost jungle location in a
high-budget adventure film or AAA exploration game.
DETAIL CONTROL
Maintain professional focal-detail hierarchy. Preserve large readable jungle
masses first, secondary structural forms next, and apply fine detail only in
primary focal regions. Avoid uniform high-frequency foliage noise or excessive
micro-detail in distant canopy layers.
QUALITY TARGET
Ultra-clean studio-grade cinematic jungle environment illustration, portfolio-
level concept art readability, strong depth hierarchy, and polished production-
ready rendering quality.

一键通用主提示词 — 远古丛林清晨
风格
高端电影风格化写实数字概念艺术，AAA 级环境关键帧插画，电影级绘景深度构建，专业游戏环境渲染，极简线条艺术，价值驱动的形态分离，手绘边缘，受控的边缘层次结构，由大到小的体量构建，干净的渐变数字色彩融合，混合手绘程序纹理，优先考虑宏观可读性，焦点结构中包含选择性微细节，工作室级构图，精良的高级制作完成度。
主题/场景
在远古丛林清晨的背景下，一个长期废弃的丛林城市广场，有破裂的雕像和藤蔓覆盖的拱门。
环境
原始的、植被茂密的丛林景观，拥有巨大的古老自然地貌，茂密的层叠植被，参天大树，盘根错节的树根，薄雾弥漫的林间空地，被大自然部分侵蚀的隐藏石质遗迹或被遗忘的小径。首先呈现清晰可辨的大型地形，具有深层环境分层，前景植被、中景丛林结构和远景树冠剪影之间有强烈的空间分离。
光照
清新的清晨丛林光照，低角度阳光透过茂密的树冠缝隙，形成结构化的定向光束。光线应清晰界定主要结构平面，同时允许柔和的大气薄雾分离深度层次，增强空间可读性，而不遮蔽主要形态。
镜头
电影探索风格的广角建立镜头，位置略高于地面，仿佛观众刚刚发现这个场景。通过植被或地形形态进行自然的前景构图，清晰的中景焦点锚点，以及深层叠的丛林远景，以强化电影绘景的深度构建。
情绪
一种古老发现、未触及的历史和宁静自然宏伟的感觉。场景应感觉像是高预算冒险电影或 AAA 级探索游戏中失落丛林地点的首次揭示。
细节控制
保持专业的焦点细节层次结构。首先保留清晰可辨的大型丛林体量，其次是次要结构形态，仅在主要焦点区域应用精细细节。避免远景树冠层中统一的高频植被噪点或过多的微细节。
质量目标
超清晰工作室级电影丛林环境插画，作品集级别的概念艺术可读性，强大的深度层次结构，以及精良的、可用于生产的渲染质量。
